scientific_queries.note: Bidirectional cross-task transfer test of the R53 predicate; no literature query.

subagent_note: None dispatched: the round reports that its own transfer test has low discriminative power rather than presenting the success as validation.

design.direction_A: GDSC threshold 3,000 applied unchanged to BATCHIE pools of 80/160/320
design.direction_B: check whether a threshold could be learned from BATCHIE at all

headline: the rule transfers only from a task whose pool range spans the crossover; BATCHIE cannot learn it
discriminative_power: BATCHIE's largest pool is 320, an order of magnitude below the threshold, so any threshold above 320 gives the same prediction and would be 'confirmed' by this data; it cannot validate 3,000 and can only falsify thresholds at or below 320
requirement_for_a_real_cross_task_test: a second task whose pool range spans roughly 1,000 to 10,000

register_updates.C37: new, exploratory: transfer is directional and one-way tests have limited power
